rv.q: While Only Human cannot rival Showman, it's a thoroughly entertaining, at times mind-warping exploration of how magical we still find the idea of being able to predict the future.
In this brand-new production, Derren Brown combines mind-reading, psychological illusion, and breathtaking storytelling in a way that is both deeply personal and utterly electrifying.
For that alone, he deserves our respect and applause.

cn.t: Brown's latest mentalism showcase earns strong reviews for its slick theatricality and his masterful ability to mesmerize audiences, blending observational skills with engaging stagecraft that leaves viewers questioning reality.
